title: Implement scheduled procedure continuation primitive
description: Implement the host-neutral scheduled-continuation exception, execution-context contract, Procedure primitive, runtime result mapping, documentation, and outside-in behavior coverage for story tcts-b872be. Preserve existing human and child wait semantics; do not add product-specific persistence or blocking sleeps.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production consumer dogfooding exposed a false-success boundary after a retryable durable-publication interruption. Implementing a generic scheduled continuation so callers can release workers and resume without returning success or using blocking sleep.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started outside-in implementation: will add BDD and unit coverage for durable, host-neutral Procedure.defer, verify red before production code, then integrate runtime mapping and documentation. No product-specific persistence or scheduling is planned.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Outside-in scheduled-continuation implementation is green locally. Added , checkpoint/replay semantics, explicit runtime and sandbox  transport mapping, CLI pause display, documentation, and fail-closed conflict validation. Red proof recorded before implementation (missing exception/primitive). Focused verification: 4 BDD scenarios/16 steps; 81 primitive/context/runtime tests; 23 continuation transport/CLI tests; targeted Ruff and Black checks. Continuing broader regressions; no commit/push per instruction.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Broader continuation compatibility checks passed: both durable wait BDD features are green with 7 scenarios and 29 steps, and the scheduled-continuation unit plus direct CLI and sandbox transport suites are green. A broad primitives/core/sandbox/CLI run reached 1275 passing and 14 failing tests. The failures are isolated to current dirty DSL handle-binding and runtime handle-enhancement areas, unrelated to scheduled continuation; no unrelated repair was attempted.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Consumer replay exposed that MemoryStorage implemented the state_set protocol incompletely and retained Lua tables tied to an expired runtime. Added red adapter coverage, then detached persisted Lua values into ordinary Python structures. The checked-in portfolio YAML now proves two consecutive scheduled retries: early replays remain WAITING_FOR_TIME, each due replay advances once, and terminal work runs only after both continuations. Focused Tactus validation: 156 passed; cross-repository Plexus runtime validation: 114 passed. No product-specific scheduling or blocking sleep added.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Combined release validation complete: full non-integration suite 4,278 passed; Behave scheduled-continuation scenarios included in 68 features/456 scenarios/2,297 steps; clean wheel exports ProcedureWaitingForTime; isolated Python 3.11 Plexus continuation and optimization consumers passed within 487 tests. No blocking sleep or product-specific scheduler added.
